# pdf.js image codecs (generated)

`pdfjs-codecs.js` is **generated by `build.sh`** from [Mozilla pdf.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js)
(Apache-2.0). It bundles the pure-JavaScript image decoders into the global `PDFJS`:

| Class | pdf.js source | Used by the app for |
|-------|---------------|---------------------|
| `PDFJS.JpegImage` | `src/core/jpg.js` | baseline/progressive JPEG (incl. CMYK/Adobe) |
| `PDFJS.JpxImage` | `src/core/jpx.js` | JPEG 2000 (`.jp2` / JPX-in-PDF) |
| `PDFJS.Jbig2Image` | `src/core/jbig2.js` | JBIG2 (fax-style bilevel images in PDF) |

Only consumer: `src/document/io/codecs/jpeg-codec.js`. Don't edit `pdfjs-codecs.js`
by hand — run `./build.sh`.

| File | Source |
|------|--------|
| `entry.js` | wrapper that re-exports the three decoders as the global `PDFJS` |
| `pdfjs-codecs.js` | `entry.js` + the pdf.js decoders + their deps, bundled by esbuild |
| `LICENSE` | pdf.js Apache-2.0 (copied by `build.sh`) |

## How build.sh works

1. **Sparse + partial clone** of *only* `pdf.js/src/` at the pinned tag into
   `src/vendor/pdfjs/` (gitignored, ≈6 MB — a full clone or submodule would be
   hundreds of MB because of pdf.js's test-PDF corpus, which we don't need).
2. Blanks `src/shared/compatibility.js` (it only `require()`s core-js polyfills for
   legacy browsers — not decoder code, and not resolvable in this bundle).
3. esbuild-bundles `entry.js` into an IIFE exposing global `PDFJS`, with a banner
   stubbing `PDFJSDev` so pdf.js's dev-only assert/debug blocks are stripped
   (i.e. a production build).

## Why pinned to v2.16.105

It's the last pdf.js line where `jpg`/`jpx`/`jbig2` are **all JavaScript** (v4+
moved JpxImage/Jbig2 to WASM) **and** the API matches what the app calls:
`JpegImage.getData({ …, isSourcePDF })`, `JpxImage.parse()` + `.tiles`/`.componentsCount`,
`Jbig2Image.parseChunks()`. JPEG decode output is verified identical to the previous
hand-extracted slice.

## Regenerating

```sh
src/vendor/js/pdfjs-codecs/build.sh        # needs Node + npx + network (clones pdf.js src, runs esbuild)
```
The output is committed, so a fresh checkout needs no rebuild.
